business_problem: BigID saw an opportunity to reimagine how organizations protect sensitive assets such as people and identity data.
solution_summary: BigID saw an opportunity to reimagine how organizations protect sensitive assets such as people and identity data. BigID’s database choice was critical. It was also a key driver behind the foundation of “We saw an opportunity to reimagine how organizations go about protecting sensitive things like people and identity data,” explained Dimitri Sirota, a co-founder and CEO at BigID. “You need it to be expansive enough to accommodate changes—both those we’d already experienced and others we can anticipate over the coming years,” Sirota said. It also needed to provide support for emerging technologies such as large language models (LLMs) and artificial intelligence (AI). “There’s a whole host of considerations, such as reporting on compliance, and data management that actually requires a recollection, a memory, a stateful persistence layer,” said Sirota.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores the operational, document, and context data behind BigID's security and compliance workloads.

data_flow: Application, customer, and workflow data is consolidated in MongoDB Atlas, indexed or enriched where needed, and then delivered to downstream applications, analytics, or AI features through low-latency queries and APIs.
business_outcome: MongoDB allows BigID to deliver its initial objectives and deal with a cross-section of data types, while also enabling new capabilities.
architecture_clues: Vector search is part of the retrieval layer for semantic or generative-AI use cases.
